source.source_name: SEC EDGAR (Electronic Data Gathering, Analysis, and Retrieval)
source.data_freshness: near real-time (submissions <1s, XBRL <1 min); ticker map refreshed regularly

headers_required.name: User-Agent
headers_required.value_hint: descriptive app name + contact email, e.g. 'corpscout/1.0 (contact@example.com)'
headers_required.note: Missing or generic User-Agent returns HTTP 403.

transport.record_path_note: Top-level JSON is an object keyed by sequential integer index ('0','1',...); each value is one company {cik_str,ticker,title}. Iterate over object values, not an array.

snapshot.note: Flatten the index-keyed object into one NDJSON line per company on ingest.

number_formats: cik_str is an integer; zero-pad to 10 digits for the canonical CIK identifier

mapping_rules.legal_name: Use 'title'; normalize inconsistent casing for display.
mapping_rules.status: Not present in company_tickers.json; leave null (status requires the submissions API, planning-only).
mapping_rules.identifier: Zero-pad cik_str to 10 digits (CIK0000000000) for identifiers.cik and primary_id when public.

live_test_plan.smoke: GET company_tickers.json with a valid User-Agent; parse first N object values.
live_test_plan.full: Process the full ticker map (~10,405 records); enrichment via data.sec.gov submissions/companyfacts only behind explicit env gates.

planning_only_enrichment.submissions_api: https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK##########.json — adds addresses, SIC, state of incorporation, EIN, former names, filings. Documented, NOT downloaded; verify shape before implementing.
planning_only_enrichment.companyfacts_api: https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK##########.json — XBRL financials; large per-company payloads; on-demand only.
